commands.title: Refresh Git Status
commands.description: Refresh the git status of the workspace repos.

commands.title: Stage All Changes
commands.description: Stage all changes (git add -A) in every workspace repo.

commands.title: Unstage All
commands.description: Unstage all staged changes in every workspace repo.

commands.title: Review Branch
commands.description: Review a worktree's working state (uncommitted and untracked files included) against the merge-base of a base and that worktree, in the editor and the git.review list. Non-destructive.

base.description: Branch, remote branch or worktree root to compare against; defaults to the repo's default base (origin/HEAD, main or master). A worktree root means its branch. `commit:<sha>` compares against that commit itself, without a merge-base; an unknown sha fails with invalid ref.

head.description: Worktree root or branch to review; defaults to the current worktree of the first git folder. A worktree, or a branch checked out in one, switches the folder to it; any other local or remote branch is reviewed read-only from its commits (merge-base, or the `commit:<sha>` base, to branch tip) without a checkout.

baseLabel.description: Label for the base side in the review header, e.g. `before turn 3`; used with `commit:<sha>`, defaults to the base.

commands.title: Swap Review Sides
commands.description: Swap base and head of the current review: the base (its worktree, else the branch read-only) becomes the reviewed head and the old head becomes the base.

commands.title: Filter Review Files
commands.description: Hide or show files in the current review (and the workspace's default for new reviews). Omitted fields keep their value.

glob.description: One custom glob to hide; empty clears it.

commands.title: Review Refs
commands.description: Fuzzy-ranked refs for the review pickers: [{ref, kind, label}], worktrees first, then local branches, then remote branches. The head worktree and its branch are left out.

query.description: Fuzzy query; empty lists everything in order.

commands.title: End Review
commands.description: End the current review and close its editor tab.

commands.title: List Worktrees
commands.description: List the git worktrees of every git folder of the workspace, the main checkout first. Returns [{repo, path, branch, head, main, current, defaultBase}]: repo is the workspace folder, path the worktree root, branch is empty when detached, head is the short SHA, current marks the worktree the folder is switched to, and defaultBase is the base git.review uses without one (origin/HEAD, main or master; omitted when none).

commands.title: Switch Worktree
commands.description: Switch a workspace folder to one of its git worktrees: the files tree, git, search, the editor and new terminals follow it. A folder that is a repo subdirectory maps to the same subdirectory of the worktree.

repo.description: Workspace folder; defaults to the first git folder.

path.description: Worktree root, as listed by git.worktrees.

commands.title: List Branches
commands.description: List the branches of every git folder that no worktree has checked out: local branches, then remote-tracking ones without a local branch of the same name, each newest commit first, at most 1500 local and 500 remote-tracking per folder. Returns [{repo, name, remote?}].

commands.title: Switch Branch
commands.description: Start switching the current worktree of a folder to a branch: a branch checked out in a worktree switches the folder to that worktree; a local branch runs git switch; a remote-tracking branch switches to its local branch, or creates it with git switch --track. Refuses at once while the folder's Neovim has unsaved buffers. Git's refusal (local changes, conflicts) is the operation's error and changes nothing. Returns {id}; poll git.worktree-op-status for the outcome, whose notice carries git's warning about commits left behind a detached HEAD.

repo.description: Workspace folder; defaults to the first git folder.

branch.description: Local branch, or remote-tracking branch such as origin/x, as listed by git.branches.

commands.title: New Worktree
commands.description: Start creating the worktree <main checkout>/.worktrees/<branch>, then switch to it. Checks out the branch when it exists, else creates it from HEAD of the current worktree. Adds .worktrees/ to .git/info/exclude when the repo does not ignore it. Returns {id}; poll git.worktree-op-status for the outcome. Fails at once on an invalid branch, an existing folder, a symlinked .worktrees, or while another git operation runs.

repo.description: Workspace folder; defaults to the first git folder.

branch.description: Branch name, also the folder name under .worktrees/.

commands.title: Worktree Operation Status
commands.description: Wait up to 1 s for a worktree create or remove started by git.worktree-new or git.worktree-remove. Returns {done, error?, path?, notice?}; path is the new worktree after a successful create, notice a warning worth showing after success.

id.description: Operation id returned by git.worktree-new or git.worktree-remove.

commands.title: Worktree Sessions
commands.description: List the workspace's running sessions whose working directory is inside the given worktree, except the editor's own Neovim sessions. Returns [{id, title}].

commands.title: Remove Worktree
commands.description: Start removing a linked git worktree: stops its Neovim and agent sessions, runs git worktree remove and, when it was current, switches the folder back to its own checkout. Never removes the main checkout, a worktree with uncommitted changes, or the branch. Returns {id}; poll git.worktree-op-status for the outcome.

repo.description: Workspace folder; defaults to the first git folder.

path.description: Worktree root, as listed by git.worktrees.

force.description: Stop the worktree's Neovim even with unsaved buffers, discarding their changes.
